steps.say: Your school has two standing links, shown here in full with a copy button beside each. The **Teacher invite link** is for anyone who will run classes; the **Admin invite link** is for anyone who needs to manage the school itself.
Whoever opens one is signed in with that role, with no sign-up form to fill in. Send them however you normally reach staff — email, Teams, a message, or written on a board.
Anyone who has already joined is listed underneath, so you can see who is in. A teacher does not need to speak the language: the app does the teaching.
steps.terminal: That is step two — copy, send, and watch the list fill. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
